content: When administering intravenous iloprost, it is critical to closely monitor the patient. Consider temporarily discontinuing any concomitant vasodilators or other medications that lower blood pressure to reduce the risk of additive hypotensive effects. If hypotension persists despite stopping other antihypertensive agents and providing fluid resuscitation, a reduction in the iloprost dose or its discontinuation should be considered. When iloprost is co-administered with alprostadil intravenously, the vasodilatory effects of both drugs may be enhanced due to additive mechanisms. Therapy should be adjusted, and the patient should be closely monitored. When iloprost is co-administered with amantadine, the pharmacodynamic interaction may lead to synergistic effects. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are recommended. When iloprost is co-administered with amifostine, the pharmacodynamic interaction may reduce the toxicity of either drug. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are advised. When iloprost is co-administered with amiodarone, the pharmacodynamic interaction may enhance the effects of either drug. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are necessary. When iloprost is co-administered with amphotericin B (cholesteryl sulfate, deoxycholate, liposomal, or phospholipid complex formulations), the pharmacodynamic interaction may enhance the effects of either drug.
